# Claude Skills for Business Intelligence

> A free agent skill and the eleven principles of certified business intelligence,
> from Kymira. They teach Claude Code, Cursor and any agent with a system prompt to
> build charts, dashboards and reports whose every figure reconciles to a total the
> source file itself asserts, and to name what the file cannot prove instead of
> shipping it as a number. MIT licensed.

## Files in this repository
- [honest-dataviz/SKILL.md](https://github.com/dylnbaker15/claude-skills-for-business-intelligence/blob/main/honest-dataviz/SKILL.md): the free skill. When something should be a chart at all, which form the data's job selects, colour that survives a colour-blind reviewer, and how not to imply more certainty than the data has.
- [honest-dataviz/honest-dataviz.mdc](https://github.com/dylnbaker15/claude-skills-for-business-intelligence/blob/main/honest-dataviz/honest-dataviz.mdc): the same skill as a Cursor rule.
- [honest-dataviz/AGENTS.md](https://github.com/dylnbaker15/claude-skills-for-business-intelligence/blob/main/honest-dataviz/AGENTS.md): the same skill for agents that read AGENTS.md.
- [honest-dataviz/plain-prompt.md](https://github.com/dylnbaker15/claude-skills-for-business-intelligence/blob/main/honest-dataviz/plain-prompt.md): the same skill with no tool-specific framing.
- [DOCTRINE.md](https://github.com/dylnbaker15/claude-skills-for-business-intelligence/blob/main/DOCTRINE.md): the eleven principles of certified BI, in full.
- [doctrine_gate.py](https://github.com/dylnbaker15/claude-skills-for-business-intelligence/blob/main/doctrine_gate.py): a plain script that reads a finished artifact and fails the build when a principle is broken.
- [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/dylnbaker15/claude-skills-for-business-intelligence/blob/main/INSTALL.md): install routes for Claude Code, Cursor and other agents.

## Install
- One command: `npx skills add dylnbaker15/Claude-Skills-For-Business-Intelligence`
- Claude Code by hand: copy `honest-dataviz/` into `~/.claude/skills/`
- Cursor: copy `honest-dataviz/honest-dataviz.mdc` into `.cursor/rules/`
- As a plugin: `/plugin marketplace add dylnbaker15/Claude-Skills-For-Business-Intelligence`, then `/plugin install kymira-certified-bi@kymira`

## Elsewhere
- [The skill page](https://kymira.ai/skills/honest-dataviz)
- [The failure catalogue](https://kymira.ai/failure-modes): 51 observed ways a number goes wrong, each tied to the principle that addresses it
- [The doctrine](https://kymira.ai/doctrine)
- [The live demo](https://kymira.ai/demo/): a working intranet where every figure reconciles to source
- [The free tier and the paid packs](https://kymira.ai/get?tier=free)

## Limits
- This repository is one skill and the doctrine. The paid Kymira packs hold the other skills, the 351-definition Metric Library and the 47-format Format Library; they are not in this repository.
- The skill is instructions for an agent, not a program. It does not read your files by itself, ships no data anywhere, and needs an agent to run.
- Nothing here is a hosted tool or a database. It assumes you already have exports and an agent that can read them.
